note: Alberta Parks PRA campground run by the Fox Creek Development Association for West Fraser, about 25 km SW of Hinton off Hwy 16 and 3 km of gravel. The sites sit close together in one open clearing at the edge of Kinky Lake; non-motorized or electric-powered boats only; free firewood. An Alberta Parks low-water advisory for the area's boat launch (since April 23, 2024) also names this campground. --Claude
